subject: Next steps & invoice requirements for Redwood pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmecorp.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & invoice requirements for Redwood pilot

Hi Sarah & Tom 

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the pilot: 

Summary:
- Pilot: 3-week evaluation (up to 500k tokens/month) running on Redwood Dedicated.
- Goal: validate latency + cost vs current stack; integrate inference routes to staging.

Action items I captured:
1) ACME to confirm procurement path (PO vs card) and internal billing contact  Sarah
2) ACME to share invoice requirements (billing address, VAT/tax IDs, purchase order format)  Sarah / AP
3) Redwood to share SOW + invoice template and confirm net terms  Marissa (attached)
4) Schedule kickoff once PO or payment method is confirmed  Dylan to schedule

A few clarifications from our side: 
- We can accept POs (standard) or card for initial pilot. For POs we typically issue invoices on receipt of your PO number; our standard net terms are Net-30 once credit is approved.
- We included an invoice template and a draft SOW for signature (attached). If you need a specific invoice format, let us know and we can adjust.
- For marketplace purchases (AWS/GCP) we can support that path as well  let us know if ACME prefers marketplace procurement.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf, Invoice_Template.xlsx

Please confirm the billing address, tax/VAT ID to include on the invoice and whether AP prefers invoices emailed to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com or uploaded to a vendor portal.

Thanks  looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(650) 555-0123

From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@acmecorp.com>, accounts-payable@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & invoice requirements for Redwood pilot

Marissa  thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from procurement/AP: 

1) Procurement path: ACME prefers to use purchase orders for new vendors. We'll issue a PO for the pilot.
2) Net terms: AP typically evaluates Net-30 but requires a credit application for any vendor asking for net terms. Is Redwood able to accept Net-30 contingent on a simple credit check?
3) Invoice fields: We need the invoice to include the following:
   - Full legal name: ACME Corporation
   - Billing address: ACME Corporation, Attn: Accounts Payable, 400 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94111
   - Tax ID / VAT: US EIN 12-3456789 (we'll confirm if VAT applies)
   - PO number field (we will provide PO number once issued)
4) Invoice delivery: please send invoices to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com and upload to Coupa (we'll share the vendor portal link after we onboard you).
5) DocuSign: we'll need the SOW countersigned; legal may request a redline.

Cc'ing AP so they have visibility. AP, please confirm if additional documentation (W-9, certificate of insurance) is required.

We plan to turn the PO within 3-5 business days once legal signs off.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
Sr. Procurement Manager | ACME Corporation
sarah.jenkins@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@acmecorp.com>, Tom Evans <tom.evans@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>, accounts-payable@acmecorp.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & invoice requirements for Redwood pilot

Thanks Sarah  that all makes sense. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Net terms: We can accommodate Net-30 contingent on a brief credit review. I'll loop in Lukas (cc'd), our Finance lead, to start the credit application and expedite approval.
- Invoice format: Attached is the Invoice_Template.xlsx filled with Redwood's billing details; we can include the PO number field and your billing address exactly as provided.
- W-9 and COI: We'll provide a W-9 and the standard COI; I'll get those into AP's inbox today.
- DocuSign / SOW: We're happy to accept redlines. I'll open a DocuSign envelope for the SOW (link will follow) and highlight the sections we typically don't change for pilots.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I will send W-9 + COI to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com by end of day.
2) Lukas will send a short credit form to Sarah to enable Net-30.
3) Sarah to confirm PO issuance and provide PO number back to me.
4) Dylan to schedule kickoff for the week after PO is received.

If that timeline works, I'll get the DocuSign + invoice to you today.

Best,
Marissa

---
Attachments: Invoice_Template.xlsx (filled), Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & invoice requirements for Redwood pilot

Hi Sarah  quick note from our side. Thanks for moving this forward. I'll hold on scheduling kickoff until we have the PO number, but happy to lock in tentative time slots next week (Tue/Wed 10-12 PT).

Lukas  appreciate you helping with the credit form; if we can fast-track Net-30 for the pilot that will unblock start immediately after PO. 

Marissa  once AP confirms they'll accept the W-9/COI and we have PO, I'll send a calendar invite and include our integration doc so ACME's engs have prework.

Thanks  looking forward to getting ACME onboarded.
